catalog.eventImageHelp: Shown in the event list and the public registration form header.
catalog.runnerGuideHelp: PDF or Word document with race instructions. Each event has its own guide.
catalog.imageHelp: PNG, JPG, or WEBP images up to 4 MB are accepted. The system adjusts the aspect ratio automatically without cropping.
catalog.documentHelp: PDF or Word documents (.doc, .docx) up to 15 MB are accepted.
catalog.paymentQrHelp: Shown to the athlete after registration with the exact amount to transfer.
catalog.paymentQrDetail: This is the QR code each registrant sees with the amount they must pay. It should point to the account that receives the collection.
catalog.fileFormatHelp: The format is verified by reading the file, not by its extension.
catalog.modalitiesHelp: Event distances with their kits and prices.
catalog.athleteFinalPrice: Final price paid by the athlete
catalog.ageCategoriesHelp: Age is evaluated on the event date, not the registration date. Default ranges are managed in Settings.
